codex.robotica.guide.title: Your next steps
codex.robotica.guide.all_done: Every step is done. Robotica is yours.
codex.robotica.guide.missing: The guide steps are missing from this resource pack.
codex.robotica.guide.click: Click an icon for its recipe
advancements.robotica.guide.root.title: Robotica
advancements.robotica.guide.root.descrip: The Codex shows your next steps and every recipe.
advancements.robotica.guide.mainspring.d: Wind a Mainspring at a Winding Crank.
Place Stumpy by trees or Sprout by crops, next to a chest.
advancements.robotica.guide.robot_workin: Right-click your robot with the wound Mainspring.
advancements.robotica.guide.hammer.title: Hammer Time
advancements.robotica.guide.first_iron.d: Smelt iron: it makes a generator, a battery and power tools.
advancements.robotica.guide.hauler_drone: Craft a Hauler Drone Mk1 and pick up a mob with it.
advancements.robotica.guide.charger.desc: Place a Charger next to the generator.
advancements.robotica.guide.tesla.title: Plugged In
advancements.robotica.guide.tesla.descri: Put a Tesla Coil on your generator and link a machine to it.
advancements.robotica.guide.power_tool.d: Smith your hammer into a Bore Drill or your axe into a Chainsaw.
advancements.robotica.guide.basic_circui: Craft a Basic Circuit. It opens most of Age 1.
advancements.robotica.guide.exo.title: Suit Up
advancements.robotica.guide.drones.title: Air Support
advancements.robotica.guide.drones.descr: Craft a Sentry or Courier Drone Mk1.
advancements.robotica.guide.rancher.desc: Craft a Rancher Mk1 and place it in an animal pen.
advancements.robotica.guide.upgrade_card: Craft an upgrade card and right-click a robot or machine with it.
advancements.robotica.guide.farm_kit.des: Upgrade a robot with a Farm Kit Mk2.
advancements.robotica.guide.warp.title: Home Run
advancements.robotica.guide.warp.descrip: Place and power two Warp Pads, then travel between them.
advancements.robotica.guide.ferrothorium: Make Ferrothorium in an Alloy Smelter.
advancements.robotica.guide.diamonds.des: Find diamonds: they make the Excavator Mk1 and the Age 2 parts.
advancements.robotica.guide.excavator.de: Place an Excavator with a chest next to it.
advancements.robotica.guide.age2.title: Age 2: Servo
advancements.robotica.guide.age2.descrip: Craft an Advanced Circuit or a Reinforced Casing.
advancements.robotica.guide.rtg.title: Slow Burn
advancements.robotica.guide.rtg.descript: Place a Radioisotope Generator and fuel it.
advancements.robotica.guide.foundry.desc: Find a Rusted Foundry (copper ruins in plains, deserts, badlands) or craft a Signal Flare.
advancements.robotica.guide.colossus.des: Summon and beat the Scrap Colossus.
advancements.robotica.guide.servo_core.d: Get a Servo Core: it makes the Servo Drill and the Mob Replicator.
Smith your Bore Drill into a Servo Drill.
advancements.robotica.guide.vial.title: Sample Size
advancements.robotica.guide.age3.title: Age 3: Deep
advancements.robotica.guide.pyrolite.des: Mine Pyrolite Ore in the Nether, most of it in basalt deltas.
advancements.robotica.guide.cinder_forge: Find a Cinder Forge (blackstone ruins in Nether caves) or craft an Ignition Charge.
advancements.robotica.guide.tyrant.title: Quenched
advancements.robotica.guide.tyrant.descr: Summon and beat the Forge Tyrant.
advancements.robotica.guide.magma_core.d: Get a Magma Core: Magma Drill, Arc Blade, Rift Upgrade, Age 3 mobs in the replicator.
Smith a Magma Drill. Turn on auto-smelt in its settings.
advancements.robotica.guide.exo_mk3.desc: Smith an Exo piece to Mk3. Flight needs a Mk3 chestplate.
advancements.robotica.guide.age4.title: Age 4: Antigrav
advancements.robotica.guide.resonite.des: Mine Resonite Ore on the outer End islands.
advancements.robotica.guide.antigrav_cor: Get an Antigrav Core: Null Drill, Null Lance, Portal Projectors.
advancements.robotica.guide.null_drill.d: Smith a Null Drill and dig a 12x12x12 cube in one swing.
advancements.robotica.guide.fusion.title: Star in a Jar
advancements.robotica.guide.fusion.descr: Build and light the Fusion Reactor.
advancements.robotica.guide.flight.title: Lift Off
advancements.robotica.guide.flight.descr: Put a Flight Module in an Exo chestplate and press %s to fly.
advancements.robotica.guide.exo_mk4.desc: Smith an Exo piece to Mk4.
advancements.robotica.guide.portal.title: Through the Lens
advancements.robotica.guide.portal.descr: Link two Portal Projectors with a Linking Card and step through the portal.
